pages.text: The owner-bound interface may be placed in any dimension. Nine mixed targets cache items, fluids and installed external resources. Empty-hand left-click clears a target; right-click edits quantity and its six-face mask.

Active Pull drains every storable resource from enabled adjacent faces, not just configured targets. Active Push exports real caches, but only through faces allowed by that slot's output face mask. Faces default Disabled; this never rejects another mod's passive capability access.

FE, Botania Mana and Ars Source consume the real interface cache first. Only a shortfall atomically converts Immortal Power using server settings. Directionless Botania spark and Ars block interactions ignore face modes.

Release: clearing or retargeting a cache slot atomically returns its non-empty buffer to Xianqiao; empty-hand left-click on a configured slot returns and clears it. Breaking the interface also returns every cache to Xianqiao first, keeping only un-placeable overflow in compact dropped-item data that resumes on re-placement.
